name: God of Chains
source:
Disciple Tamea is sent to explore the ruins of the Cursed City, where she must find an entrance into the temple of Amarh Nayon, also known as God of Chains. Portals to the temple are protected by many traps and guarded by several demons, who dwell in the flying towers. And these perverted and sinful creatures take a high price for the opportunity to open all the portals.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/silicone_knight]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
弟子塔米亚被派去探索被诅咒之城的废墟，她必须在那里找到进入阿玛纳永神庙的入口，阿玛纳永神庙也被称为锁链之神。通往神殿的门户受到许多陷阱的保护，并由居住在飞塔中的几个恶魔看守。这些变态和罪恶的生物为了打开所有门户的机会付出了高昂的代价。

[编辑自[url=https://www.patreon.com/silicone_knight]Patreon[/url]]
